monsters.name: Goblin

abilities.name: Nimble Escape

abilities.name: Scimitar Slash

monsters.name: Goblin Boss

abilities.name: Redirect Attack
abilities.description: Swaps places with a nearby underling to make it take the hit.

abilities.name: Multiattack

monsters.name: Hobgoblin

abilities.name: Martial Advantage

monsters.name: Bugbear

abilities.name: Surprise Attack

abilities.name: Brute

monsters.name: Kobold

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.description: Attacks with advantage while an ally is beside the same target.

monsters.name: Orc Warrior

abilities.name: Aggressive
abilities.description: Charges toward the nearest enemy as a bonus action.

abilities.name: Greataxe Swing
abilities.description: A two-handed axe blow.

monsters.name: Orc War Chief
monsters.description: A battle-scarred leader whose presence drives the whole warband harder.

abilities.name: Battle Fury
abilities.description: Adds crushing extra damage to every hit.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.description: Allies who can hear it attack with advantage this round.

monsters.name: Gnoll
monsters.description: A hyena-headed marauder driven by an endless, screeching hunger.

abilities.name: Rampage
abilities.description: Moves and bites again immediately after felling a creature.

monsters.name: Bandit
monsters.description: A desperate or greedy roadside robber with a crossbow and bad intentions.

abilities.name: Scimitar Slash
abilities.description: A quick curved-blade cut.

monsters.name: Bandit Captain

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: Turns aside one melee attack per round.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: Two scimitar strikes and a dagger throw.

monsters.name: Cultist
monsters.description: A robed fanatic who believes the ritual is worth whatever it costs.

abilities.name: Dark Devotion
abilities.description: Immune to fear while the ritual continues.

monsters.name: Cult Fanatic
monsters.description: A cult leader with real, borrowed divine power and no restraint about using it.

abilities.name: Dark Devotion
abilities.description: Immune to fear.

abilities.name: Inflict Wounds
abilities.description: A necrotic touch that withers flesh.

monsters.name: Guard

abilities.name: Spear Thrust
abilities.description: A disciplined thrust from behind a shield.

monsters.name: Veteran

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: Two longsword strikes and a shortsword follow-up.

monsters.name: Knight

abilities.name: Brave

abilities.name: Leadership

monsters.name: Mage

abilities.name: Fire Bolt
abilities.description: A mote of flame streaks at a target.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.description: A detonating sphere of flame.

abilities.name: Shield
abilities.description: A force barrier turns aside one attack.

monsters.name: Priest

abilities.name: Guiding Bolt
abilities.description: A lance of light that marks the target.

abilities.name: Cure Wounds
abilities.description: Restores an ally's vitality.

monsters.name: Assassin

abilities.name: Assassinate
abilities.description: Automatic critical against a surprised target.

abilities.name: Poison Blade
abilities.description: A coated shortsword.

monsters.name: Berserker
monsters.description: A wild frontline fighter who ignores wounds until the fight is over.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.description: Attacks with advantage and is struck just as easily.

monsters.name: Druid
monsters.description: A guardian of the old places who would rather warn you off than fight.

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.description: Roots erupt and hold intruders.

abilities.name: Wild Shape
abilities.description: Assumes the form of a beast.

monsters.name: Skeleton

abilities.name: Shortbow Shot
abilities.description: A rattling, accurate shot.

monsters.name: Zombie
monsters.description: A shambling corpse that keeps coming long after it should have fallen.

abilities.name: Undead Fortitude
abilities.description: Refuses to drop unless the killing blow is radiant or a critical hit.

monsters.name: Ghoul
monsters.description: A ravenous corpse-eater whose claws lock a victim rigid.

abilities.name: Paralyzing Claws
abilities.description: A raking strike that freezes the victim in place.

monsters.name: Wight
monsters.description: A once-mortal warrior bound to unlife, able to raise those it kills.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: Drains vitality and lowers the victim's maximum health.

monsters.name: Wraith
monsters.description: A malevolent spirit that passes through walls and drains the living.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
abilities.description: Moves through creatures and solid objects.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: A chilling touch that steals vitality.

monsters.name: Specter
monsters.description: A restless shade that hates the warmth of the living.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: A cold, wasting touch.

monsters.name: Mummy
monsters.description: A bound and cursed corpse that punishes tomb robbers precisely as promised.

abilities.name: Dreadful Glare
abilities.description: A stare that roots the victim in terror.

abilities.name: Rotting Fist
abilities.description: A blow that spreads mummy rot.

monsters.name: Vampire Spawn
monsters.description: A newly turned thrall, fast and thirsty and not yet subtle.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: A bite that drains blood and heals the spawn.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Wounds close each round unless burned or blessed.

monsters.name: Lich
monsters.description: An archmage who traded death for eternity and now has centuries of preparation behind it.

abilities.name: Paralyzing Touch
abilities.description: A touch of pure cold that locks the body.

abilities.name: Finger of Death
abilities.description: Necrotic energy tears the target apart.

abilities.name: Frightening Gaze
abilities.description: A look that empties the courage from a room.

monsters.name: Ogre
monsters.description: A dull-witted giant that solves everything with a tree trunk.

abilities.name: Greatclub Smash
abilities.description: A crushing overhead blow.

monsters.name: Hill Giant
monsters.description: Enormous, hungry, and entirely willing to eat the horses.

abilities.name: Boulder Throw
abilities.description: Hurls a rock the size of a barrel.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: Two greatclub swings.

monsters.name: Frost Giant
monsters.description: A raider from the far north in mail made of frozen scale.

abilities.name: Greataxe Swing
abilities.description: A blow that can cleave a horse in two.

abilities.name: Icy Grip
abilities.description: A freezing hold that numbs the limbs.

monsters.name: Troll
monsters.description: A gangly, foul-smelling regenerator that only fire and acid keep down.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Regrows wounds each round unless burned or dissolved.

abilities.name: Rending Claws
abilities.description: Two raking claws and a bite.

monsters.name: Owlbear
monsters.description: A territorial nightmare with the beak of an owl and the temper of a bear.

abilities.name: Keen Smell
abilities.description: Tracks by scent with uncanny accuracy.

abilities.name: Beak and Claw
abilities.description: A beak strike and a raking claw.

monsters.name: Harpy
monsters.description: A winged predator whose song draws travellers off the cliff path.

abilities.name: Luring Song
abilities.description: A song that pulls listeners helplessly toward it.

monsters.name: Basilisk
monsters.description: A heavy, slow lizard whose gaze turns flesh to stone.

abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
abilities.description: Meeting its eyes begins turning a creature to stone.

monsters.name: Mimic
monsters.description: A shapeshifting predator that has been a treasure chest since before you entered the room.

abilities.name: Adhesive
abilities.description: Anything that touches it is stuck fast.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: Indistinguishable from an ordinary object while still.

abilities.name: Pseudopod
abilities.description: Melee attack: +5 to hit, reach 1.5 m, 1d8+3 bludgeoning. If the mimic is in object form the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee attack: +5 to hit, reach 1.5 m, 1d8+3 piercing plus 1d8 acid.

monsters.name: Gelatinous Cube
monsters.description: A transparent ten-foot cube of acid that cleans corridors very thoroughly.

abilities.name: Engulf
abilities.description: Moves through a creature's space and absorbs it.

monsters.name: Rust Monster
monsters.description: Harmless to flesh, catastrophic to anyone in plate armor.

abilities.name: Rust Metal
abilities.description: Corrodes any metal weapon or armor it touches.

monsters.name: Animated Armor
monsters.description: An empty suit of plate that stands up when the room is entered.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: Two slamming gauntlet blows.

monsters.name: Flesh Golem
monsters.description: Stitched together from many donors and animated by lightning.

abilities.name: Lightning Absorption
abilities.description: Lightning heals it rather than harming it.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: Attacks the nearest creature, friend or otherwise, when badly wounded.

monsters.name: Imp
monsters.description: A tiny devil, invisible when it wants to be, and always taking notes.

abilities.name: Sting
abilities.description: A poisoned tail sting.

abilities.name: Shapechange
abilities.description: Becomes a rat, raven, or spider at will.

monsters.name: Succubus
monsters.description: A fiend that never needs to draw a weapon to ruin someone.

abilities.name: Charm
abilities.description: Binds a victim's affection completely.

abilities.name: Draining Kiss
abilities.description: Feeds on the victim's life force.

monsters.name: Hell Hound
monsters.description: A pack hunter from the lower planes that breathes fire.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.description: Attacks with advantage while an ally is beside the same target.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: A cone of hellish flame.

monsters.name: Air Elemental
monsters.description: A howling vortex of living wind.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.description: Sweeps up everything nearby and flings it away.

monsters.name: Fire Elemental
monsters.description: A roaring humanoid shape of pure flame that ignites what it touches.

abilities.name: Fire Form
abilities.description: Burns anyone who touches it and sets fire to what it passes.

monsters.name: Earth Elemental
monsters.description: A slab of animate stone that swims through the ground.

abilities.name: Earth Glide
abilities.description: Moves through stone and earth as easily as air.

monsters.name: Water Elemental
monsters.description: A surging wave with intent behind it.

abilities.name: Whelm
abilities.description: Engulfs and drowns creatures in its space.

monsters.name: Dryad

abilities.name: Fey Charm
abilities.description: A word that makes an enemy into a devoted friend.

abilities.name: Tree Stride
abilities.description: Steps into one tree and out of another.

monsters.name: Pixie
monsters.description: A tiny, invisible fey with a dangerous sense of humour.

abilities.name: Superior Invisibility
abilities.description: Invisible at will, even while acting.

abilities.name: Sleep Dust
abilities.description: A pinch of dust that drops a target where it stands.

monsters.name: Mind Reaver
monsters.description: A mind reaver that regards your skull as a lunch container.

abilities.name: Mind Blast
abilities.description: A cone of psychic force that stuns everything caught.

abilities.name: Extract Brain
abilities.description: Kills an incapacitated target outright.

monsters.name: Many-Eyed Horror
monsters.description: A floating sphere of eyes, paranoia, and ten separate ways to end you.

abilities.name: Antimagic Cone
abilities.description: Its central eye suppresses all magic in a wide cone.

abilities.name: Eye Rays
abilities.description: Three random rays from its ten eyestalks.

monsters.name: Young Red Dragon
monsters.description: An arrogant adolescent dragon already convinced the valley belongs to it.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: A cone of roaring flame.

abilities.name: Frightful Presence
abilities.description: Its sheer presence unnerves everything nearby.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: A bite and two raking claws.

monsters.name: Adult White Dragon
monsters.description: A cold, feral hunter that keeps its kills frozen for later.

abilities.name: Cold Breath
abilities.description: A cone of killing frost.

abilities.name: Frightful Presence
abilities.description: Terror radiates from it.

monsters.name: Ember Wyrm
monsters.description: A serpentine lesser dragon that nests in volcanic vents and breathes embers.

abilities.name: Ember Breath
abilities.description: Exhales a cone of scorching embers.

abilities.name: Wing Buffet
abilities.description: Strikes nearby foes with a winged gust.

monsters.name: Wyvern
monsters.description: A two-legged dragon cousin with a venomous stinger and no interest in conversation.

abilities.name: Stinger
abilities.description: A tail sting that pumps in venom.

monsters.name: Treant
monsters.description: An ancient awakened tree, slow to anger and impossible to reason with once it is.

abilities.name: Animate Trees
abilities.description: Wakes two nearby trees to fight alongside it.

abilities.name: Rock Throw
abilities.description: Hurls a boulder with enormous force.

monsters.name: Shambling Mound
monsters.description: A heap of rotting vegetation that engulfs and digests.

abilities.name: Engulf
abilities.description: Wraps a creature inside its mass.

monsters.name: Stirge
monsters.description: A fist-sized flying bloodsucker that latches on and does not let go.

abilities.name: Blood Drain
abilities.description: Attaches and drains blood each round.

monsters.name: Cute white rabbit
monsters.description: looks like small, cute rabbit, with fluffy fur and red eyes, does not attack unprovoked.

abilities.name: Dash bite
abilities.description: caster dashes through target without giving reaction chance and deals basic bite damage

monsters.name: Corpse dolly
monsters.description: dolly made of sewed parts of various different corpses, controlles by magic and desires to kill particular creature.

monsters.name: Diamond Card Soldier
monsters.description: Medium construct (♦), CR 1/2. AC 13, HP 22 (4d8+4), speed 9 m. Passive Perception 10. Immune to poison and frightened. Every card soldier in the Queen's courtyard - in the queue and on the walls - is a diamond; there is no other suit here. When it dies it does not fall: it flutters, and takes a whole round to settle.

abilities.name: Paper Halberd
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack: +5 to hit, reach 3 m (10 ft), 1d10+3 slashing.

abilities.name: Flat
abilities.description: Passive. Takes half damage from piercing and slashing attacks (the paper closes over the wound) and double damage from fire.

abilities.name: Edgewise
abilities.description: Bonus action. Turns sideways, vanishes and reappears in any free space it can see within 4.5 m (15 ft). Does not provoke opportunity attacks.

abilities.name: Sniff
abilities.description: Passive. It cannot read - it sniffs the paper. 'The Twins' pass' and 'Notice of having already been checked' are genuine; every other paper is a forgery.

abilities.name: Bribe
abilities.description: Passive. Always accepts a beer coupon: stops checking, shoulders its halberd and walks off to the bar - even in the middle of a fight. It never comes back.

monsters.name: Clubs & Spades Card Soldier
monsters.description: Medium construct (♣/♠), CR 1/2. AC 13, HP 22 (4d8+4), speed 9 m. One of the forty flat, painted soldiers that line the walls of the Queen's audience hall behind the Cross Door - every one a club or a spade, not one red card in the room. They act on the Queen's initiative and shield her: any attack on the Queen from farther than 1.5 m hits a card instead. If someone touches the hollow in her chest they throw the offenders out of the hall.

abilities.name: Paper Halberd
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack: +5 to hit, reach 3 m (10 ft), 1d10+3 slashing.

abilities.name: Flat
abilities.description: Passive. Takes half damage from piercing and slashing attacks (the paper closes over the wound) and double damage from fire.

abilities.name: Edgewise
abilities.description: Bonus action. Turns sideways, vanishes and reappears in any free space it can see within 4.5 m (15 ft). Does not provoke opportunity attacks.

abilities.name: Forty Cards
abilities.description: Reaction. When a creature attacks the Queen from more than 1.5 m away, this soldier steps into the way and becomes the target instead.

monsters.name: The Caretaker
monsters.description: Large undead, CR 8 (3900 XP). AC 16 (grave-dirt hide), HP 157 (15d10+75), speed 9 m. Saves STR +10, CON +9, WIS +7; Athletics +10, Perception +7. Resistant to necrotic and piercing; vulnerable to fire. Immune to poison, charmed and frightened. Blindsight 9 m, tremorsense 18 m through the rose-bed soil, passive Perception 17. A hunched gravedigger nearly three metres tall. He has no face - only grey skin stretched tight and stitched shut with black thread where a face should be. His arms are too long and sewn on from somebody else; the stitches weep. He carries a shovel taller than a man, the blade black and bitten. The Queen's old gardener, dug up and put back to work: he still paints the white roses red, and what he paints with comes from whoever stands last in the queue. He does not speak, except one word. Multiattack: two Shovel attacks; every shovel hit heals him for the damage it deals - but only while he stands on the rose-bed soil. Tactics: 'Kneel.' first, then the shovel; Shovel Slam when three or more are close; Rise. whenever it recharges. He never leaves the garden; past 9 m from the beds he goes back to painting. Scaling: too hard - the dead rise only once and Rise. does not recharge; too easy - +30 HP and the dead start at four. When he dies he kneels, for the first time; the stitches on his face open, and there is only soil inside.

abilities.name: Grave Soil
abilities.description: Passive. He moves through the rose beds (difficult terrain) at normal speed; anyone else takes 1d4 piercing for every 1.5 m moved through them. His life drain only works while he stands on the rose-bed soil. Off the soil (on the paving, the gravel path, or a bed that has been burned) he cannot regain HP at all - put 'No Healing' on him until he steps back onto the soil.

abilities.name: Shovel (Multiattack x2)
abilities.description: Two attacks. Melee weapon attack: +10 to hit, reach 3 m (10 ft), 2d8+6 bludgeoning plus 5 necrotic. He regains HP equal to all the damage dealt (life drain) - unless he is off the rose-bed soil. Against a kneeling or prone target it scores a critical hit on 18-20.

abilities.name: Shovel Slam
abilities.description: Recharge 5-6. He drives the shovel into the ground. Every other creature within 4.5 m: CON save DC 16, 4d10 bludgeoning and knocked prone on a failure, half damage and standing on a success. The ground there cracks into difficult terrain, and the soil it throws up is rose-bed soil.

abilities.name: Rise.
abilities.description: Bonus action, Recharge 5-6. He taps the shovel twice on the soil. Two Rose-Bed Dead claw their way up anywhere on the beds within 9 m and act on his initiative. Never more than four at once. At the start of the fight two are already standing.

abilities.name: Kneel.
abilities.description: Bonus action. One creature within 9 m that can hear him - though he has no mouth: WIS save DC 15 or prone, and it cannot stand up until the end of its next turn.

abilities.name: Rising from Your Knees
abilities.description: Reaction. When a prone or kneeling creature within 3 m stands up, he hits it with the shovel (as one Shovel attack, life drain included).

monsters.name: Rose-Bed Dead
monsters.description: Medium undead, CR 1 (200 XP). AC 11, HP 22 (4d8+4), speed 6 m. Vulnerable to fire and radiant; immune to poison. Darkvision 18 m, passive Perception 9. Somebody who once stood last in the queue. Rose roots grow through the ribs and out of the mouth; most still hold a crumpled petition. They do not moan. They queue. Acts on the Caretaker's initiative. If anyone says the name 'Lily' aloud, every Rose-Bed Dead loses its next action, and one of them - small, in a girl's dress - turns its head toward the third bush.

abilities.name: Clutch
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack: +4 to hit, reach 1.5 m, 1d8+2 bludgeoning, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). A creature held by the dead cannot stand up from prone, and the Caretaker's attacks against it have advantage.

abilities.name: Back to the Soil
abilities.description: When it drops to 0 HP on the rose-bed soil, roll d6: on a 6 it sinks back in and rises again at the start of the Caretaker's next turn with 5 HP. Fire or radiant damage stops this.

monsters.name: The Mad Hatter (Cursed)
monsters.description: Medium humanoid, CR 5 (1800 XP) - VETERAN chassis. AC 15, HP 90 (12d8+36), speed 9 m. Saves DEX +6, CHA +7; Deception +7, Sleight of Hand +6, Perception +3; passive Perception 13. Polite, apologetic, occasionally drops an octave mid-sentence. He knows he is cursed and fights it the whole battle, and loses. Tactics: never leaves the long table - if the party refuses to come, the table stretches toward them 3 m per round. THE HAT is a valid target: AC 12, 25 HP, moves; damaging it does nothing to him but makes something inside scream - anyone hearing it makes a DC 12 WIS save or spends its reaction staring (it is the Rabbit). At half HP he stops laughing mid-laugh (read the box). If the party drank the right cup he starts at half HP with the teapot already spent. LAW OF THE TABLE: each hat (d4, the only mandatory roll per round) also sets a law until his next turn; everyone seated repeats it aloud; breakers are punished by the table. Death: he does not fall, the laughter stops, every hat of the fight drops onto every chair at once, he gives his last law in his own voice ('Everyone drink'), all seated toast empty cups, the hat rolls to rest mouth-up and ticks, he becomes a Joker card again - and beside each player's plate lies a place card with their name in his handwriting.

abilities.name: A Dozen Hats / Law of the Table
abilities.description: At the start of each of his turns roll d4 (the only mandatory roll each round). The hat changes what he is AND sets the law of the table until his next turn; he announces it an octave lower and everyone seated repeats it in unison. 1 top hat - 15 temp HP, mocks; LAW 'Only questions!' (any non-question speech, incl. verbal spell components, breaks it). 2 bonnet - one creature DC 15 WIS or charmed until end of his next turn and moves toward him; LAW 'Clean cup, move down!' (ending a turn where you started breaks it). 3 helmet - AC 18, cannot move; LAW 'No one taller than the host!' (ending a turn standing breaks it). 4 no hat - he is himself, does not attack, says something bitter and useful about Alice; the hat speaks in the Rabbit's voice: LAW 'No one looks at him.' (attacking him breaks it).

abilities.name: Hat Brim (Multiattack x3)
abilities.description: Three attacks with the brim of his hat: +6 to hit, reach 1.5 m, 1d6+3 slashing each.

abilities.name: Sit Down!
abilities.description: Opening move. Every creature within 9 m: STR save DC 14 or it is dragged to a chair at the table and restrained until it uses an action to break free (DC 13 Athletics). A seated character has disadvantage on attacks against anyone not seated at the table.

abilities.name: Tea / Teapot
abilities.description: Recharge 5-6. Stat block: throws a cup - 6 m cone of boiling tea, DEX save DC 14, 4d6 fire; on a failure the target's mouth is burned and it cannot speak until the end of its next turn. (Encounter variant: 9 m line, 5d6 fire, DEX DC 14 half.) He apologises after every use: 'Sorry. Sorry. It's hot.'

abilities.name: Pull from the Hat
abilities.description: Action (instead of Hat Brim; roughly every other turn, or right after someone breaks a law). He reaches into the hat and rolls d12: 1-6 a beast jumps onto the table and attacks on its own initiative (1 dormouse pile, 2 bandersnatch pup, 3 jabberwock hatchling, 4 bread-and-butterfly swarm, 5 rocking-horse-fly, 6 March Hare); 7-12 a weapon he uses instead of his normal attack (7 vorpal butter knife, 8 boomerang tea tray, 9 old flamingo mallet, 10 clock stuck at six, 11 sugar tongs, 12 roll twice). If the hat is bloodied or damaged, roll with disadvantage (pick the less dangerous result).

abilities.name: The Table Punishes
abilities.description: Free, not an action. Whoever breaks the current law of the table takes 2d8 psychic (no save) and the chair drags them back to the table: restrained, as Sit Down!

abilities.name: Madness
abilities.description: Reaction. The first time he drops to 0 HP he doesn't. He stands back up with 25 HP and a single hat left. He no longer laughs - the hat laughs for him, in his voice. Stop rolling the d4: the last law stays in force for the rest of the fight and the hat whispers it every turn.

monsters.name: Animated Tea Service
monsters.description: Small construct, CR 1/4. AC 13, HP 17 (5d6), speed 9 m (hops along the table). Blind beyond 9 m, immune to poison, psychic, charmed, frightened. Teapot, cups and saucers rattling across the long table on the Hatter's initiative. (The script gives no stat block - these are DM-improvised numbers; remove them if the party struggles.)

abilities.name: Scalding Pour
abilities.description: Melee attack: +4 to hit, reach 1.5 m, 1d6+2 fire.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.description: When it drops to 0 HP it bursts into porcelain shards: every creature within 1.5 m makes a DEX save DC 12 or takes 1d6 slashing.

monsters.name: Dormouse Pile (swarm)
monsters.description: Pulled from the Mad Hatter's hat (d12 = 1). A dozen sleeping rodents snoring together. SWARM: AC 10, HP 22, speed 9 m.

abilities.name: Bites
abilities.description: Melee attack: +4 to hit, 2d6 piercing (1d6 if the swarm is at half HP or less).

abilities.name: Drowsy
abilities.description: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space: CON save DC 12 or drowsy - on its next turn it can take an action or move, not both.

monsters.name: Bandersnatch Pup
monsters.description: Pulled from the Mad Hatter's hat (d12 = 2). Fur, teeth, far too many teeth. AC 13, HP 30, speed 12 m.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee attack: +5 to hit, 2d6+3 piercing. On a hit: STR save DC 13 or knocked prone.

monsters.name: Jabberwock Hatchling
monsters.description: Pulled from the Mad Hatter's hat (d12 = 3). Small - exactly the size of your dog - and its eyes already burn. AC 14, HP 25, fly 9 m. It cries when it dies, very childishly.

abilities.name: Flame
abilities.description: Recharge 6. 4.5 m cone, 3d6 fire, DEX save DC 13 for half.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee attack: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 slashing.

monsters.name: Bread-and-Butterfly Swarm
monsters.description: Pulled from the Mad Hatter's hat (d12 = 4). Yes, really. SWARM: AC 12, HP 15, fly 12 m.

abilities.name: Engulf
abilities.description: Wraps one creature: it has disadvantage on attacks while the swarm lives and takes 1d4 damage every round (butter in the eyes hurts surprisingly).

monsters.name: Rocking-Horse-Fly
monsters.description: Pulled from the Mad Hatter's hat (d12 = 5). A wooden horse with wings, buzzing. AC 13, HP 20, fly 12 m.

abilities.name: Hoof
abilities.description: Melee attack: +5 to hit, 1d10+3 bludgeoning. Rocking: after every hit it rocks 3 m back without provoking opportunity attacks.

monsters.name: The March Hare
monsters.description: Pulled from the Mad Hatter's hat (d12 = 6). The Hatter's old friend - or what is left of him. Ears hang like broken cups, eyes roll in different directions; he recognises the Hatter and grins with every tooth he has and a few he doesn't. Impossibly fast: at the end of the table, then at your shoulder, with nothing in between. AC 15, HP 33, speed 24 m, doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

abilities.name: Kick (Multiattack x2)
abilities.description: Two kicks: +6 to hit, 2d6+3 bludgeoning each.

abilities.name: Again!
abilities.description: Reaction, once per round. When he is hit, or when he misses, time snaps back six seconds: that attack never happened. The attacker rerolls and the second result stands, or the Hare attacks again. Every cup on the table clinks at once.

abilities.name: Mad
abilities.description: Every round roll d2: 1 = attacks the party, 2 = attacks the Hatter ('The tea is cold! The tea is ALWAYS cold! Again! AGAIN!').

monsters.name: The White Rabbit (Clockwork)
monsters.description: Small beast (clockwork), CR 6 (2300 XP). AC 17, HP 105 (14d8+42), speed 24 m, doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Saves DEX +9, WIS +8; Perception +8, Acrobatics +9. Truesight 9 m, passive Perception 18. 1.2 m tall, a once-beautiful waistcoat, fur that was once white - torn away in patches over wet, tiny gears turning in time with his breathing - holding the pocket watch in both hands like a bird. He does not want to kill them; he wants them to be late. Talk first - fight, persuade (DC 20) or steal (DC 20 Sleight of Hand) are all valid. He never attacks a downed character: he kneels, ear to its chest, and counts its remaining seconds aloud - always a little fewer than the player expected. At 0 HP he does not die: he sits down heavily and his hands open.

abilities.name: Out of Order
abilities.description: Passive. He acts first every round, on initiative 30, no matter what anyone rolled.

abilities.name: Between Seconds
abilities.description: Passive. At the end of every other creature's turn he moves up to 6 m for free. He is never seen moving - only somewhere else.

abilities.name: Pin Strike (Multiattack x2)
abilities.description: Two pin strikes: +9 to hit, 1d6+5 piercing plus 2d6 psychic each, as one second of the target's life runs out early.

abilities.name: Delay
abilities.description: Recharge 4-6. One creature: WIS save DC 16. On a failure it skips its next turn entirely - he simply wasn't there for it.

abilities.name: Late
abilities.description: Bonus action. He touches a creature: its next turn happens at the very end of the round instead of where it should. No save.

abilities.name: Tick (Click)
abilities.description: Reaction, 3 times per fight. When another creature ends its turn, he undoes that turn: the creature returns to where it started, and all damage and effects from that turn are undone - but spent resources and actions stay spent and it does not act again. The players remember. Read aloud: click. Fire returns to the palm. The arrow lies back on the string. The Rabbit hasn't moved. He smiles. 'Once more. Until you get it right.'

abilities.name: Pocket Watch Rewind
abilities.description: Recharge 5-6, at most TWICE per fight. He winds the watch backwards: the fight returns to the start of the Rabbit's previous turn - all damage and effects since then (spent spells, conditions, movement, rolled dice) are undone. Use the battle map's ⟲ Rewind button; the app restores everything automatically. What does not rewind: the players' memories - they remember what happened and may act differently. The recharge itself stays spent. Read aloud: the ticking stops. Then - click - and everything goes backwards. His wounds zip shut in his fur. 'Again,' he says. 'Again. We will do this as many times as it takes.'

abilities.name: Time Seam (Lair)
abilities.description: On initiative 20 a random 3 m square of the tower runs at a different speed: everything in it at the start of a turn makes a CON save DC 14 or loses its action. Clock-room variant: four flickering seams - roll d4 at the end of each round for which quarter is FAST (extra action) and which is SLOW (half speed, no reactions); tell the players before they act.

monsters.name: Alice (Twisted)
monsters.description: Small humanoid (child). AC 10, HP - (999 here only so the battle map never drops her), speed 9 m. She has no CR: she is not a fight. Damage dealt to her lands, is described as landing, and then simply isn't. Don't roll her saves; don't count her HP. The encounter ends when the script says it ends - round 3, with the gnome. Nobody dies in these three rounds: heroes drop to 0 and are stable; death saves here are made with advantage.

abilities.name: She Interrupts
abilities.description: On her turn one thing about the room, or one creature in it, becomes true because she said so. No attack roll, no save. Never more than one per turn, never something that kills outright. Options: 'You're a chair.' (a hero is a chair until the end of her next turn) / 'That's not yours.' (the Last Note is in her hand now) / 'Down.' (every hero within 9 m is prone and takes 3d6 bludgeoning) / 'Come, let's see' (takes the most interesting hero's hand - it drops to 0 HP unless someone is immediately more interesting).

abilities.name: Boring
abilities.description: Passive. A creature that spends a whole turn doing nothing interesting cannot be targeted by her on her next turn - she forgot it was there.

abilities.name: The House
abilities.description: Passive. Within 18 m of her every piece of furniture is a mimic and acts on her initiative. Round 1 of 'Run': every hero ending its turn within 3 m of furniture makes a DEX save DC 14 or takes 2d6 and is grappled (escape DC 13).

abilities.name: Attention Counter
abilities.description: 0-10, kept openly. Thresholds 3/5/7/9; at 10 she raises her head (go to 'The Gaze'). +1 noise, combat round, verbal spell within 18 m, waking a mimic, being interesting; +2 saying her name or falling from 6 m; +3 taking the note.

monsters.name: The Queen of Hearts
monsters.description: Medium humanoid, CR 8 (3900 XP) - and she must never be fought. AC 17, HP 136 (16d8+64), speed 9 m. Saves CON +8, WIS +7, CHA +9; Insight +7, Persuasion +9, Intimidation +9; passive Perception 13. Not an enemy; this block is for emergencies only. She attacks on exactly one condition: someone touches the hollow in her chest. If that happens, don't roll a battle - play one round, show them what she is, and have the card soldiers throw them out of the hall.

abilities.name: Procedure
abilities.description: Passive. She cannot be deceived, charmed or frightened - there are no emotions left to grab.

abilities.name: Take It From Her
abilities.description: Once per turn she names one creature she can see and one object it carries. The object is now hers, in her hand. No save - it is a rule, not a spell.

abilities.name: Forty Cards
abilities.description: Passive. Every card soldier in the room acts on her initiative and covers her; any attack on her from farther than 1.5 m hits a card instead.

abilities.name: The Hollow
abilities.description: A creature that touches the hollow in her chest takes 6d10 psychic damage and is paralysed for one minute, living through sixty years of a woman who cannot want anything.

monsters.name: Doll Mimic
monsters.description: One of the nine identical porcelain dolls on the 6 m shelf in Alice's nursery - the one that is heavier, because it is full. As a MIMIC but AC 14, 30 HP, and its first attack on a surprised target has advantage and deals +2d6. Identify it with the Cheshire Cat's mirror scales (3 uses). Waking it: +1 attention and a fight on the shelf (fail any check/save by 5 = fall 6 m, 2d6 bludgeoning, +2 attention).

abilities.name: Adhesive
abilities.description: Anything that touches it is stuck fast.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.description: Indistinguishable from an ordinary object while still.

abilities.name: Ambush Bite
abilities.description: Melee attack: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 piercing. Its first attack against a surprised target has advantage and deals an extra 2d6.

abilities.name: Nursery House Rules
abilities.description: Silent: makes no sound ever, even when killed. Patient: does not pursue - a mimic that lets go turns back into furniture on the spot and waits. Counted: Alice knows how many there are; destroying one adds +1 attention at the end of the scene (don't tell them this rule until after). Every round of combat: +1 attention.
